requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure real-time processing of attendance data with updates within 2 seconds while maintaining data synchronization.
The system shall generate attendance reports within 5 seconds while retaining historical data for a minimum of 5 years.
The system shall log manual overrides focusing on critical cases to ensure accountability without excessive resource consumption.
The system shall integrate audit logs and attendance change logs for comprehensive accountability.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations when handling student attendance data.
The system shall provide transparency in attendance recording by logging all attendance changes.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall ensure that all student attendance data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict data access based on user roles.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for at least five years to comply with educational regulations.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records only after successful authentication.
The system shall verify the integrity of attendance data through checksums or hashes.
The system shall provide a mechanism for users to report unauthorized access or data breaches.
The system shall enforce session timeouts to log out users after a period of inactivity.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing operations by implementing efficient algorithms.
The system shall support cloud storage solutions that prioritize energy-efficient data centers.
The system shall allow for real-time attendance updates using low-energy communication protocols.
The system shall provide an option to generate reports in formats that minimize digital resource usage.
The system shall notify users of their carbon footprint based on attendance patterns.
The system shall ensure data retention policies align with sustainable resource management practices.
The system shall offer a user interface that is optimized for low-power devices.
